body.label: Target
body.html: One adjacent enemy, or one unsecured small object within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and pull a hit enemy 1 unit. An unattended object instead moves into your hand without opposition.

surges.html: After a hit, move 1 unit around the enemy.
A hit enemy cannot make movement Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Chimera
rider.html: Assume Digits (upkeep 0): you may hold one extra small object, but gain no additional weapon Source, Action, Reaction or item use.
